name: Focus On Me
source:
A scary story mainly focused on Monika and trying to save the other Dokis. Monika has complete control over the world and constantly tries to keep the player and the protagonist focused on her and only her. Not Natsuki. Not Sayori. Not Yuri. Not the grammar. Can you stay focused or will you veer of course?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200511220454/http://ddlcmods.com/focus-on-me/]DDLCmods[/url]]
